mentions.name: Toolbit
mentions.description: Toolbit is a privacy-friendly developer toolbox that bundles everyday utilities such as a JSON formatter, JWT decoder, Base64 encoder, and Markdown previewer into a single, consistent interface. It runs completely client-side for quick, distraction-free workflows, organizes tools by category in a clean sidebar, and is available as a PWA.
mentions.problem: The author kept opening random web tools for tiny tasks; most are full of ads and it's unclear whether data is shared with the backend.
mentions.audience: Built for developers who need quick, everyday utilities.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’ve been working on Toolbit — a simple developer toolbox

https://toolbit.pages.dev

This privacy-friendly developer toolbox that bundles a bunch of everyday utilities (JSON formatter, JWT decoder, Base64 encoder, Markdown previewer, etc.) into a single, consistent interface.

It works completely on client side and designed for quick, distraction-free workflows.
